question: What's the best online learning platform for corporate employee training?
text:
If you mean a platform companies use to train their own employees, rather than a consumer course site like Coursera or Udemy, my top pick in 2026 is Docebo.

My shortlist
Platform	Best for	My take
Docebo	Large/complex organizations	🏆 Best overall
360Learning	Collaborative, employee-generated training	Best for internal expertise
LearnUpon	Straightforward employee training	Best for ease of use
Cornerstone	Very large enterprises + talent management	Best enterprise suite
D2L Brightspace	Structured learning & sophisticated programs	Best for complex learning environments
🏆 Best overall: Docebo

Docebo combines an enterprise LMS with AI-powered content creation, personalized learning, skills management, analytics, automation, compliance/certification tracking, and a content marketplace with 30,000+ courses. It can also support employees, customers, and partners on the same platform.
